s: golden and silver vessels (from the Jerusalem temple) originates from temple in Jerusalem (taken by Nebuchadnezzar)
q: the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem

s: Belshazzar's feast has attendees a thousand lords
q: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords

s: Belshazzar is a Chaldean king
q: Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain.

s: writing on the wall reads MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN
q: This is the writing that was inscribed: ‘MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.’

s: writing on the wall is written on plaster of the wall of the king's palace (near the lamp stand)
q: wrote near the lamp stand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace

s: hand that wrote is a man's hand fingers
q: the fingers of a man’s hand came out and wrote

s: hand that wrote is sent from Most High God (sent from before him)
q: Then the part of the hand was sent from before him, and this writing was inscribed.

s: Belshazzar's kingdom has state counted and brought to an end (MENE interpretation, by God)
q: MENE: God has counted your kingdom, and brought it to an end.

s: Belshazzar's kingdom is given to Medes and Persians (divided)
q: PERES: your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

s: Darius the Mede receives Belshazzar's kingdom (aged about sixty-two)
q: Darius the Mede received the kingdom, being about sixty-two years old.

s: Belshazzar son of Nebuchadnezzar
q: You, his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this,

s: Belshazzar has state has not humbled his heart (lifted himself against the Lord of heaven)
q: You, his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this,

s: Belshazzar praises idol gods (of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, stone)
q: You have praised the gods of silver, gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone, which don’t see, hear, or know

s: Belshazzar is slain slain (on the night of the writing)
q: In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain.

s: Daniel is a Jewish captive (of the children of the captivity of Judah)
q: Are you that Daniel of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?

s: Daniel also named Belteshazzar (name given by the king)
q: the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar

s: Daniel has attribute excellent spirit, knowledge, understanding (interpreting dreams, dissolving doubts)
q: an excellent spirit, knowledge, understanding, interpreting of dreams, showing of dark sentences, and dissolving of doubts were found in the same Daniel

s: Daniel is a president (one of three presidents)
q: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one;

s: Darius the Mede appoints three presidents (over the local governors)
q: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one;

s: Darius the Mede issues royal decree (Darius's thirty-day decree) (signed)
q: Therefore King Darius signed the writing and the decree.

s: Darius the Mede has residence Darius's palace
q: Then the king went to his palace

s: Most High God is living God (steadfast forever)
q: for he is the living God, and steadfast forever.

s: Most High God has kingdom indestructible (dominion lasts to the end)
q: His kingdom is that which will not be destroyed. His dominion will be even to the end.

s: Most High God has attribute deliverer (works signs and wonders)
q: He delivers and rescues. He works signs and wonders in heaven and in earth

s: presidents and local governors is accountable to Darius the Mede (local governors give account to presidents so the king suffers no loss)
q: that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss.

s: presidents and local governors opposes Daniel (sought occasion against him)
q: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom

s: royal decree (Darius's thirty-day decree) prohibits petition to any god or man except the king (for thirty days; penalty is the den of lions)
q: that whoever asks a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

s: royal decree (Darius's thirty-day decree) is governed by law of the Medes and Persians (cannot be changed)
q: that it not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.

s: Daniel has attribute excellent spirit
q: because an excellent spirit was in him

s: den of lions has part stone (sealing the den) (sealed with signets of the king and his lords)
q: A stone was brought, and laid on the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords

s: Daniel's prayer is directed to Most High God (petition, supplication and thanks)
q: and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.

s: Daniel's prayer faces Jerusalem (windows open in his room)
q: now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem

s: Daniel has attribute faithful (no error or fault found in him)
q: but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful.

s: Daniel is a child of the captivity of Judah
q: That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah

s: Daniel serves Most High God (continually)
q: Your God whom you serve continually, he will deliver you.

s: Daniel has habit Daniel's prayer (three times a day, kneeling, with windows open toward Jerusalem)
q: he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.

s: Daniel prospers under Cyrus the Persian (also under Darius)
q: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

s: Darius the Mede rules kingdom of Darius
q: in all the dominion of my kingdom

s: Darius the Mede appoints one hundred twenty local governors (over the kingdom)
q: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors

s: Daniel has Daniel's dream and visions (in the first year of Belshazzar)
q: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head on his bed.

s: third animal (leopard) has dominion (given to it)
q: and dominion was given to it.

s: fourth animal has iron teeth (great; also bronze nails)
q: It had great iron teeth.

s: fourth animal has ten horns
q: It had ten horns.

s: fourth animal is a fourth kingdom on earth (different from all kingdoms; will devour the whole earth)
q: The fourth animal will be a fourth kingdom on earth, which will be different from all the kingdoms, and will devour the whole earth

s: four great animals is a four kings (who will arise out of the earth)
q: These great animals, which are four, are four kings, who will arise out of the earth.

s: four great animals comes from great sea (different from one another)
q: Four great animals came up from the sea, different from one another.

s: ten horns is a ten kings (arise out of the fourth kingdom)
q: As for the ten horns, ten kings will arise out of this kingdom.

s: little horn has eyes like a man's and a mouth speaking great things
q: in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things.

s: little horn opposes saints of the Most High (makes war and prevails)
q: the same horn made war with the saints and prevailed against them

s: little horn opposes Most High God (speaks words against; plans to change times and law)
q: He will speak words against the Most High, and will wear out the saints of the Most High.

s: Belshazzar is a king of Babylon
q: Belshazzar king of Babylon

s: Ancient of Days has white clothing and wool-like hair (clothing white as snow)
q: His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool.

s: Ancient of Days has fiery throne (wheels burning fire)
q: His throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.

s: everlasting kingdom has everlasting dominion (will not pass away)
q: His dominion is an everlasting dominion, which will not pass away, and his kingdom will not be destroyed.

s: saints of the Most High possesses everlasting kingdom (forever)
q: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.

s: thrones and judgment has books (opened when judgment was set)
q: The judgment was set. The books were opened.

s: Daniel keeps the matter in his heart (after the vision)
q: but I kept the matter in my heart.

s: first animal (lion with eagle's wings) is like lion (has eagle's wings)
q: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings.

s: first animal (lion with eagle's wings) has man's heart (given to it after wings were plucked)
q: A man’s heart was given to it.
